Give Hope. Create Change.

Every gift powers investigations, policy reforms, and plant-based progress that move us closer to a world free of factory farming.

Your gifts bring hope—to animals, people, and our planet—and help build a more just and compassionate food system.

Thanks to a group of generous animal advocates, your impact will be amplified—every dollar you give will be met with another. Don’t miss this chance to boost your impact for animals! 

By supporting Mercy For Animals, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. We'll update you on our latest successes and alert you to opportunities to take further action to prevent cruelty and inspire compassion. You may unsubscribe at any time. Donations will be used where needed most.

By providing your phone number, you agree that Mercy For Animals and its agents or volunteers may contact you by phone call and mobile text message regarding Mercy For Animals programs, events, and membership.

If you have questions about your gift or would like more information, please visit our FAQ section.
